retrieval: v3, k=3; three indexed fictional case studies per persona
model_control: Model blocked by job; every architecture sees the same model for that job
human_approval: App graph pauses without approval; only separate research simulator scored
outcomes: Independent synthetic clients; deterministic rule model, one transaction follow-up
quality: Post-hoc independent judge, calibrated on a separate human packet; coverage reported
x2: Hand-graph intention-to-treat reply rate by preassigned opening strategy
hypothesis: Hand graph catches more unsupported claims/policy violations at higher token cost
known_limits: Small procedural job families and fictional evidence; not an independently labelled real-job set
Supervisor uses analyst/writer specialists; role granularity differs from production graph
Native baselines can choose verification tools; hand graph mandates verification
Shared provider pacing and warm retrieval can affect latency; order randomized before outcomes
Rule-client reply rates are not real-world effectiveness; no model quality inferred from tests
